annotations.title: Request a missing task or tool

description: Ask Ahel to add a data task or provider tool the catalog does not have yet: call it when capability_search answers verdict none and none of its nearest items fits. Give what you need in plain words, an example input, and the most you would pay for one call. Answers a request id; asking again for the same thing adds to that request instead of making a new one. Free; runs nothing and charges nothing. NOT for: finding what already exists, which is capability_search.

example_input.description: Optional: one example input, as text or an object (a domain, a profile URL, a name).

max_price_usd.description: Optional: the most you would pay for one call, in USD.

what.description: What you need done, in plain words: the job, not a provider name.

name: catalog_request
title: Request a missing task or tool
